tour.title: System Overview & Entry Points
tour.description: Start with README.md and app.py to understand how lok unifies FFmpeg video montage, Gemini Vision narration, and local neural TTS generation. Both the CLI workflow and the studio server build on these shared media primitives.

tour.title: Web Studio UI & Client State
tour.description: The web studio frontend is built with index.html, app.js, and style.css for RTL Arabic property workflows. It handles session cookies, video drag-and-drop, opt-in feature toggles, polling, and live editable shot scripts.

tour.title: Starlette API & Multi-Tenant Auth
tour.description: web/server.py exposes REST endpoints for uploads, processing jobs, cut text updates, voice samples, and music catalogs. Account authentication, quotas, and prompt presets are backed by SQLite modules auth_db.py and prompt_db.py.

tour.title: Production Principles & Configuration
tour.description: AI narration dialect, walkthrough perspective, voice tone, and music/visual defaults are persisted in config/production_principles.json and managed at runtime through production_principles_manager.py.

tour.title: End-to-End Video Production Bridge
tour.description: web/pipeline_bridge.py coordinates every production stage after upload: directive parsing, proxy montage slicing, continuous narration synthesis, synchronized captions, background music ducking, and instant cut-text re-renders.

tour.title: Gemini Multimodal Vision & TTS
tour.description: web/vision_analyzer.py analyzes keyframes with Gemini Vision to infer property features and Arabic narration matched to scene durations, while tts/gemini_speech/client.py synthesizes speech with multi-key failover.

tour.title: FFmpeg Montage, Overlays & Captions
tour.description: Low-level FFmpeg video editing, visual lower-thirds, and CapCut-style animated .ass subtitles live in web/video_editor.py, web/video_annotator.py, web/caption_templates.py, assemble_video.py, and frame_extractor.py.
